New plugin desk-review: a simplify-then-review skill whose report opens in a side pane, each item unfolding in place to its diff or its current source.

- `/desk-review:simplify-review [target]` runs `/simplify` on your changes and then `/code-review medium`, so the review also sees what the cleanup changed. The report lists every cleanup fixed or skipped and every finding found or dismissed, each with its file, line and reason
- The report opens in desk-review's pane (`/desk-review` opens the last one again). Press an item to unfold it in the pane: a fixed item shows its diff hunk, the others the source around its line as the file is now; `◫ Open in the Changes tab` opens desk-look's diff pane at that file
- desk-look opens its diff pane when desk-review asks (`state.set` on desk-review's `diffAt`), and `/desk-update` updates desk-review too
- desk-asana, desk-slack, desk-plan and desk-grant move to 0.73.0 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-review@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`. desk-review is new, so install it once with the second line.
